inputs.prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] A single continuous ten-second cinematic LIVE-ACTION martial-arts fight, already in motion from Picture 1. EXACTLY the same two adult human actors, masks, black hoods, human proportions, wet practical cloth costumes and sunlit ruined stone courtyard. Scorpion in yellow and black LEFT; Sub-Zero in blue and black RIGHT. Continue the extended icy punch in the starting picture immediately. Same medium-wide side view, both full bodies and boots visible; slight tracking follows their physical retreat. Preserve the original actors' facial identity and costume materials.

Fast compact fighting at NORMAL SPEED: every strike snaps out, hits or glances aside, and instantly whips BACK. A parry is a short sideways slap redirecting an incoming wrist, followed immediately by separation. Contact occupies a few frames. The receiver keeps reacting after the striking hand has already returned. Counterattacks start DURING the other fighter's retraction. Hard body hits visibly fold a torso, turn a pelvis and force catching steps. Both try to hurt, evade and interrupt the other, with intense focused eyes and serious stunt commitment.

Scorpion turns his head outside the incoming icy fist, sharply knocks that wrist aside with his lead hand, and drives a compact RIGHT body hook into Sub-Zero's exposed ribs. The yellow fist immediately springs back. At the hit Sub-Zero's ribs fold, his hips shift away and his rear boot catches his weight. During this recoil he snaps an icy LEFT jab at Scorpion's face and immediately follows with a RIGHT cross. Scorpion slips the jab, redirects the cross with a brief slap and fires a LEFT body punch before the blue arm has returned. The punch lands, separates and drives Sub-Zero back a planted step.

Scorpion pursues that retreat with a sharp RIGHT straight and a LEFT front kick into the torso. His punching hand has already retracted as the knee rises. The kick hits, folds back at the knee and the boot lands immediately. Sub-Zero's upper body snaps back from the impact and he takes two urgent catching steps. As Scorpion lands, Sub-Zero plants his support boot, turns his hips and whips a short RIGHT kick into the outside of Scorpion's forward thigh. The yellow knee yields after the kick and his other boot catches his weight. The blue leg retracts and lands at once. Scorpion answers during that recovery with a short fiery RIGHT body punch. Sub-Zero turns his torso, takes the glancing hit and immediately returns an icy LEFT hook; Scorpion ducks beneath it and steps inside for the next counter as the shot ends. The fight keeps advancing through contact, separation, recoil, pursuit and reversal instead of resetting.

Scorpion owns ORANGE FIRE: a small tight flame runs along HIS striking fist and trails briefly during acceleration, vanishing on retraction. Sub-Zero owns BLUE-WHITE ICE: the frost already on HIS forearms moves with his limbs; small ice chips scatter AFTER a parry or hit. Orange fire and blue ice meet briefly at glancing contacts, producing a small steam puff that disperses while both actors keep moving. Powers never require a held pose, pressed-together arms or a beam struggle. The effects do not obscure the bodies or substitute for their physical reactions. Preserve wet clothing and existing frost on the stone. No new freeze, weapons, extra people, deliberate slip, floor trap, comic acting, slow motion, cuts or camera shake.

overall_soundscape: Fast synchronized compact punch impacts, heavier body-hit thuds, short parry slaps, urgent catching footfalls and cloth snaps over quiet courtyard wind. Short fire swishes on yellow attacks and brittle ice ticks after blue contacts, with brief steam hiss. No speech, grunts, laughter or music.

non_diegetic_music: None.

_meta.title: T03 — glancing parries, landed body hits, immediate overlapping counters
